deals.deal: Moe Monday: Discounted Burrito or Bowl with Free Chips and Salsa for Moe Rewards Members
deals.desc: Every Monday, Moe Rewards members (free account) get a full-size burrito or bowl at a reduced price with the always-free chips and salsa, in the restaurant, online or in the app. The offer appears automatically in the Moe Rewards account each Monday; no code. Moe's says the price varies by location (commonly $6.99 to $8.99), so check the app before ordering. Single use per Monday; add-ons extra; not valid with other offers or third-party delivery. Stated on Moe's own Moe Monday and offers pages.

deals.deal: Buy One Get One Free Footlong for Sub Club Members
deals.desc: Sub Club members (free account) get a free Footlong of equal or lesser value with any Footlong purchase in the app or online; choose turkey or veggie for a healthier pick.

deals.deal: $1 Bottomless Fountain Drinks for PERi-Perks Members
deals.desc: PERi-Perks members (free account) can add a bottomless fountain drink to any meal for $1 instead of the usual $3.99, in app, online or in-restaurant.
deals.region: DC, MD, VA, IL, TX & GA

deals.deal: $5 Regular Sandwich for McAlister's Rewards Members
deals.desc: Friday, October 30 through Wednesday, November 3: McAlister's Rewards members (free account) get any regular sandwich for $5, in the app or online with the reward applied at checkout. Reported by USA Today on October 28 from the chain's National Sandwich Day announcement; participating locations.

Any regular-sized ramen bowl for $7 through November 15: enter code RAMEN7 at noodles.com checkout or give the code at the counter. Open to everyone, no account needed; one per order, not on third-party delivery or catering, participating locations, while the chain's redemption cap lasts. The code and its terms are on Noodles' own offers terms page.

deals.deal: National Sandwich Day: $5 Medium Sandwiches for Schlotzsky's Rewards Members
deals.desc: October 31 through Tuesday, November 3: any medium sandwich for $5 with a free Schlotzsky's Deli Rewards account, in the restaurant or on the app. Stated on Schlotzsky's own homepage; participating locations, not combinable with other offers.

deals.deal: Fire-Grilled Combos from $5.99: Pollo Bowl, Chicken Burrito or 3 Tacos al Carbon with Chips and a Drink
deals.desc: El Pollo Loco's value combos (Original Pollo Bowl, Classic Chicken Burrito, 3 Tacos al Carbon) come with chips and a regular drink for $5.99 to $6.99 at a Los Angeles store on order.elpolloloco.com, checked October 3, 2026. The chain advertised them at $5 through 2022; prices vary by market.

deals.deal: Sub of the Week: $2 Off This Week's Featured Whole Sub
deals.desc: Every week Publix takes $2 off one featured whole deli sub (a Boar's Head turkey sub or the Publix Deli Ultimate Sub, for example, about $8.99 instead of $10.99), fully customizable at the counter, online or in the app. The featured sub changes with the weekly ad; the deli's weekly specials page lists it.
Naf Naf Grill's value menu: a full pita meal for $9.99, in store and in the app, every day at participating locations.

deals.deal: Kids Eat Free: Free Chicken or Tofu Mini Bowl with Each Full-Price Entree
deals.desc: Every day: one free kids Chicken or Tofu Mini Bowl with the purchase of any full-price entree, weekdays after 4 PM and all day Saturday and Sunday, at all WaBa Grill locations. No account or coupon needed. Stated in WaBa Grill's own press release and on its homepage.
deals.expires: Weekdays after 4 PM, all day weekends

deals.deal: Club Luna Kids Eat Free: Free Kids Meal with Each Adult Entree, Dine-In
deals.desc: Monday through Thursday, Club Luna Rewards members (free app account) get one free kids meal per adult entree, up to two per check, for children 10 and under, dine-in only with the child present. Show the offer in the Luna Grill app when ordering. All locations except San Diego Airport; not combinable with other offers.

deals.deal: MyPollo Monday: Original Family Meal for $15 (Regularly $20.99)
deals.desc: Every Monday, MyPollo Rewards members (free app account) get the Original Family Meal, citrus-marinated grilled chicken with family-size sides, for $15 instead of the $20.99 listed on the chain's site. Order in the app or online with the reward applied, or show the app in the restaurant; participating Florida locations.

deals.deal: Tropic Fan Fest: Free 24 oz Smoothie with Any Bowl or Food Purchase, Every Day
deals.desc: November 2 through 8: Tropic Rewards members (free account) get a free 24 oz smoothie with any Tropic Bowl or food item, once a day, all week. Add the food and a smoothie to an app or tropicalsmoothiecafe.com order and tap Apply on the Tropic Fan Fest reward, or scan the app in the cafe; the credit covers the lowest-priced 24 oz smoothie. Excludes Toasted Snack Rolls, the Sunshine Smoothie, sides, sweets and kids' items; participating cafes.
